findings.fp_reason: The nopriv AJAX handler is protected by an effective nonce check (check_ajax_referer at AbandonedCarts.php:41) using action string 'abandoned-carts'. The nonce is issued to all front-end visitors via wp_localize_script (AbandonedCarts.php:69), so this is the intended design for unauthenticated cart tracking. The email input at line 42 is sanitized with sanitize_text_field() at entry. It is further sanitized via sanitize_email() before DB storage (CartRepository.php:225). All DB operations (insert, update, delete, get) use wpdb's prepare(), $wpdb->insert(), $wpdb->update(), and $wpdb->delete() — no raw SQL concatenation with user input. No output sink (echo/print) is reached from this entry point. No exploitable vector survives refutation.

fp_evidence.defense: check_ajax_referer('abandoned-carts', 'nonce') at entry; sanitize_text_field() on $_POST['email']; sanitize_email() + Encrypt::encrypt() before storage; wpdb parameterized methods throughout

negative_findings.reason: Nonce guard (check_ajax_referer) is present and effective. Email input is sanitized at entry with sanitize_text_field(), and again via sanitize_email() before DB storage. All DB operations use wpdb parameterized APIs. No output sink reachable from this path.

All queries use $wpdb->prepare(), $wpdb->insert(), $wpdb->update(), and $wpdb->delete() with typed placeholders. Customer email is encrypted via Encrypt::encrypt(sanitize_email()) before persistence. No raw SQL concatenation with user-supplied values.
